fields.label: Enable Visitor Approval
fields.description: When enabled, scans move visitors to Awaiting Approval before entry is fully approved.

fields.label: Require Visitor Photo
fields.description: Require a visitor photo before saving Visitor records.

fields.label: Require ID Number
fields.description: Require ID number before saving Visitor records.

fields.label: Auto Generate QR
fields.description: Generate a QR image automatically when a Visitor is created.

fields.label: Auto Check Out at End of Day
fields.description: Allow scheduler to check out stale active visitors after the default duration.

fields.label: Default Visit Duration (Hours)
fields.description: Used by auto checkout to decide when active visits are stale.

fields.label: Allow Multiple Active Visits
fields.description: Allow the same ID number to have more than one active visit.

fields.label: Show Visitor Photo
fields.description: Show photo in the Visitor form preview panel.

fields.label: Show QR Preview
fields.description: Show QR image in the Visitor form preview panel.

fields.label: Enable Badge Printing
fields.description: Enable visitor badge print action in the preview panel.

fields.label: Retention Period (Days)
fields.description: Number of days to keep completed records before auto archive can process them.

fields.label: Auto Archive Old Records
fields.description: Allow daily scheduler to archive old checked-out/rejected/cancelled visitors.
